summary: Iteration 15 re-checked the iteration 14 breakdown fixes on branch emergency (b4cc6f8 merged), with 4 live research runs. All 7 fixes and the UI changes pass. Backend: tests/test_breakdown.py 34/34 passed. The new tests/test_iter19_breakdown_fixes.py had 9 of 10 passing on the first run; the one failure was a mistake in my own test regex, which I fixed. tests/test_iter18_breakdown_live.py passed 13/14. Its one failure, 'call the cheapest one' (no dial_phone, reply was NOT_IN_FACTS), is flaky: it failed once and passed once. FIX1: after 'trailer, can't roll, come out to me', breakdown_kind is tire in both /agent and /breakdown/{id}, call_card.problem is 'blew a tire' and call_card.tire is 'trailer tire'. FIX2: 'never mind, take me to Reno' returns route_set to Reno with no research_id. FIX3: /api/route with skip_parking=true returned in under 3 s with parking=null. In the UI, provider-route-button showed the route card in 0.21 s, the backend log shows no parking check for the provider, and there is no 'Unlikely to fit'. FIX4: wait_time.source is 'website' for 99 Glide and the UI ETA line reads 'out within 30–60 min per website'. Only repair or labor prices are kept ($180 per hour), with no shower or diesel prices. FIX5: the check engine plus losing power utterance gets the reply 'Can it still drive, or does it need to come to you?'. FIX6: 'how far is the second one' gets the clean reply 'The second one is about four point two miles away.' FIX7: the screen summary uses digits (24/7, 2.6 mi), and the spoken reply only says 24/7 for listed 24/7 providers. UI at 390x844 (mocked /agent and /breakdown with real result data): providers-summary is clamped to 3 lines (60px), the first provider card is fully visible (471-681, list bottom 700), and chips are 36px with hitSlop top/bottom 6 (48px touch area).

minor.issue: Flaky, 1 of 2 runs failed. When only one provider posts a price, the follow-up LLM sometimes returns NOT_IN_FACTS instead of action=call, so there is no dial_phone. This passed in iteration 14, when more providers had prices; the stricter price filter now leaves only one priced provider. cheapest_fastest() returns cheapest=None when 1 or fewer providers are priced.
Prices are not de-duplicated. 99 Glide had ('hourly labor', 180) twice in one run, once from the same website quote.

The regex includes 'hour' and 'mile', which are very broad. A quote like 'Showers $15, open 24 hours' or 'diesel $4.99, 2 miles off I-80' would pass as a service price. Use 'per hour|hourly|/hr' and 'per mile|/mi' instead.

design_issues.screen: Route card for a breakdown provider
issues: Because parking is skipped, ParkingStatus shows 'Truck parking unclear' (parking-status-label) under a repair shop. It is not misleading like 'Unlikely to fit' was, but it doesn't apply to a breakdown provider. Hide the label when the route came from a provider (skip_parking).

action_items: Make 'call/route the cheapest|fastest|closest' deterministic in breakdown.followup. If exactly one provider has a price, call it and say 'Only X posts a price, $180 an hour. Calling them.' If nobody has a price, say so and offer to call the best bet (i=1) rather than returning NOT_IN_FACTS with no dial.
De-duplicate facts.prices by (what, amount_low, amount_high) in clean_facts.
Tighten SERVICE_PRICE: replace 'hour' and 'mile' with 'per hour|hourly|/hr|per mile|/mi' so fuel and shower quotes that mention '24 hours' or 'miles' are dropped.
Optional: hide the 'Truck parking unclear' label on the route card for breakdown-provider routes.
critical_code_review_comments: breakdown._handle: the pending kind and detail are kept correctly and changed_topic returns None. One gap: if the PARSE call says breakdown=false but changed_topic is not true (for example 'find a truck stop'), research still starts. Also check d.get('breakdown') is False.

fit_spoken/no_false_24_7: the guard matches on the first word of 3+ characters in the provider name. A name starting with '24/7 ...' has key '247' after tokenizing, which is fine, but generic names like 'Truck Trailer Mobile Service' have key 'truck' and will match unrelated sentences. Acceptable as a model guard.
onPlacePress decides skip_parking from providersRef membership, which is correct. Map pin taps on providers also skip parking, which is consistent.

success_rate.backend: 96% (fixes 10/10 after the test regex fix; iter18 live 13/14 with 1 flaky; unit 34/34)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (FIX3 UI, FIX4 ETA label, summary clamp, first card visible, chip hitSlop)

seed_data_creation: None. Live sessions use the t1s1-/t1s2-/t1s3-/t1p- prefixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is in frontend/.env, so export it before running the live tests. /tmp/iter19_breakdown.json holds a full tire result (99 Glide has a website-sourced ETA). Use it to mock /api/agent (researching) and /api/breakdown/** in Playwright. Live research costs about $0.13 per run; this iteration used 4.
rca_of_issue: call cheapest flake: the follow-up classification is left entirely to the LLM. With one priced provider, the prompt line 'If nobody has that fact, answer and say they don't mention it' plus cheapest=None in the code make the model sometimes refuse instead of picking the only priced provider.
